create_FrameData: create a FrameData object to store image, depth, and camera pose data for optimization frames

delete_frame_data_FrameData: delete FrameData at specified indices from an existing FrameData instance

expand_data: concatenate or replace data in a batch using numpy arrays or torch tensors
